name: Return to Fel'Zerul
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Jammal'an the Prophet sentenced me to exile from The Temple of Atal'Hakkar. I once felt the high priest was a worthy leader.

His unyielding faith in his prophecy will bring about the destruction of the Atal'ai. If it hasn't already.

When I expressed my concerns, I was labeled an infidel and ousted from the temple.

Those artifacts you brought to me are harmless. But if Jammal'an has found the proper fetish enchantment for the summoning ritual, the world lies in great peril....
narrative.offerRewardText:
It has been quite some time since we spoke, Champion. I hope your journey was successful.

What knowledge did you gain from the exiled Atal'ai in the Hinterlands?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 43 to 50, 17,850 XP in all.

quests.name: Pool of Tears
quests.objectiveText: Fel'zerul in Stonard wants you to gather 10 Atal'ai Artifacts.

quests.name: The Atal'ai Exile
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Bundle of Atal'ai Artifacts to the Atal'ai Exile in the Hinterlands.

quests.name: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar
quests.objectiveText: Collect 20 Fetishes of Hakkar and bring them to Fel'Zerul in Stonard.
